items.title: Edit Recommendation: Can LLMs Anticipate Edit Requests from Users, and When?
items.summary: After a large language model (LLM) agent generates an artifact, users often send edit requests for it. This paper studies whether an LLM can anticipate these requests before they are sent. Such anticipation is useful in practice because it reduces the effort of user review and feedback. We formalize this task as edit recommendation and build EditRecBench, a benchmark for evaluating the performance of LLMs on this task, from real-world conversation logs in WildChat-4.8M. Through benchmarking and failure analysis, we identify a practical challenge that some cases are inherently difficult to predict in real-world settings. To address this, we introduce decision model-based gating to filter out cases where predictions are unlikely to be correct before they are presented to the user. Our trained model outperforms existing decision models and raises pass@5 among shown suggestions by 12--25 points at a gating threshold. Our code is available at https://github.com/ntt-dkiku/llm-edit-recommendation.
items.tldr: EditRecBench évalue la capacité des LLM à *anticiper les demandes d'édition* des utilisateurs, avec un modèle de filtrage pour améliorer la précision. Outil pratique pour les agents interactifs et l'optimisation des workflows LLM.

items.title: WorldBridge: Bridging Scattered Views for Coherent 3D World Generation
items.summary: Generating coherent and explorable 3D worlds from scattered images with little or no visual overlap is a fundamental and long-standing challenge in computer vision, which existing geometry-aware methods fail to address. Meanwhile, existing image- and video-based methods may generate unseen regions but produce inconsistent geometry across views. To bridge this gap, we present WorldBridge, a framework for coherent and controllable 3D world generation under scattered images with little or no visual overlap. WorldBridge encodes scattered references into a global scene context to guide geometry and appearance generation across views. Our temporal and spatial reference attention mechanism further enhances the fidelity of temporal references along the target trajectory and supports flexible spatial references outside it. A plug-and-play latent-reference consistency strategy improves reference fidelity through reprojection-guided test-time optimization. We also introduce the WorldBridge benchmark suite to evaluate 3D world generation from scattered, low-overlap references, which is rarely explored by current benchmarks. Both qualitative and quantitative results demonstrate that our method enables controllable and coherent 3D world generation, surpassing the existing state-of-the-art solutions. Our project page is available at https://davidyan2001.github.io/WorldBridge/.
items.tldr: WorldBridge génère des mondes 3D cohérents à partir d'images éparses avec peu de chevauchement, via un mécanisme d'attention spatiale/temporelle et une optimisation guidée par reprojection. Avancée majeure en génération 3D contrôlable.

items.title: agentes-chat/agentes-chat
items.summary: Open-source, self-hosted Slack alternative where your team and AI agents work together in channels and DMs. Agents run on Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Gemini or Grok, with MCP tools, their own computer and browser, routines, memory and approvals. Web, desktop and phone apps. Docker Compose + Postgres. AGPL-3.0.
items.tldr: Alternative open-source auto-hébergée à Slack intégrant des agents IA (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) avec outils MCP, mémoire et automatisations, mais dépendance à des APIs externes.

items.title: BiSAT: Bidirectionally Aligned Semantic-Acoustic Tokenization for Speech Language Models
items.summary: Speech language models (LMs) generate speech as sequences of discrete tokens. Their tokenizer must therefore preserve both acoustic detail and linguistic content at a low bitrate. Semantic-enhanced tokenizers may lose acoustic detail, whereas acoustic-oriented tokenizers retain acoustic variation that makes language modeling harder. Unified tokenizers combine both, but representing acoustic detail and linguistic content within a single feature space can cause interference between the two objectives, and existing approaches typically align acoustic representations to fixed semantic targets from a frozen teacher. We propose Bidirectionally Aligned Semantic-Acoustic Tokenization (BiSAT), a unified tokenization framework with separate acoustic and semantic branches aligned by a shared-index mechanism. This design learns acoustic and semantic representations in separate continuous spaces while producing a single discrete code sequence, and it jointly optimizes both encoders without relying on fixed semantic teacher targets. Based on BiSAT, we develop BiSAT-TTS, a zero-shot text-to-speech system comprising an autoregressive text-speech LM and a conditional flow-matching acoustic decoder. Reconstruction, downstream understanding, and diagnostic analyses show that BiSAT effectively preserves semantic and acoustic information in the code stream, performs well on in-the-wild and out-of-domain speech, and learns complementary codebook representations. The frozen-code understanding results also support its feasibility and potential for code-based reward modeling in reinforcement learning post-training. BiSAT-TTS performs comparably to state-of-the-art speech LM-based TTS baselines with less training data, further supporting BiSAT's effectiveness for speech language modeling. The audio demos are available at https://seekmind-lab.github.io/bisat-demo.
items.tldr: BiSAT propose une tokenisation unifiée *semantic-acoustic* pour les modèles de parole, avec un mécanisme d'alignement bidirectionnel pour préserver à la fois le contenu linguistique et les détails acoustiques. Pertinent pour les LLM multimodaux et la synthèse vocale.

items.title: GOLD-SLAM: Gaussian-splatting Omnidirectional LiDAR-Depth SLAM
items.summary: Panoramic cameras capture nearly the entire spherical field of view in a single frame. However, the mismatch between this panoramic coverage and the field of view of LiDAR poses a substantial challenge for panoramic Gaussian splatting SLAM that relies on LiDAR depth priors. We introduce GOLD-SLAM, a Gaussian-splatting Omnidirectional LiDAR-Depth SLAM system that combines high-quality rendering with accurate geometric reconstruction. It performs tracking and mapping in the spherical domain and uses tracked visual features in regions without LiDAR coverage to improve pose estimation. To address insufficient coverage of newly observed surfaces and floating artifacts during incremental mapping, we introduce Depth-Aware Map Extension and Pruning (DAEP). To enable broader evaluation, we collect a new dataset, WHOLE, using a UAV platform across Weak-geometry, High-dynamic, Omnidirectional, Low-light, and Easy scenarios. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks and WHOLE demonstrate competitive rendering quality and improved geometric accuracy relative to perspective systems. Compared with existing panoramic baselines, GOLD-SLAM improves mean PSNR by 5.56-9.10 dB and reduces mean Depth-L1 by 71.9-83.9%. To assess deployment feasibility on resource-constrained platforms such as UAVs, we evaluate an embedded configuration of GOLD-SLAM on a Jetson Orin NX (16 GB), demonstrating online operation at the cost of reconstruction quality.
items.tldr: GOLD-SLAM combine LiDAR et *Gaussian splatting* pour une reconstruction 3D omnidirectionnelle précise, avec un nouveau dataset WHOLE pour évaluer les scénarios difficiles. Pertinent pour la robotique et la vision panoramique.

items.title: LayoutRecall: Preserving Appearance in Multi-Round 3D Layout-Controlled Image Editing
items.summary: 3D layout-controlled image editing gives users explicit control over object placement and camera viewpoint. In a sequence of edits, however, the latest image can lose the appearance of an object when it is occluded or leaves view. The target layout specifies where the object should reappear, while its appearance must be recovered from earlier observations. We introduce LayoutRecall, a multi-round editor that stores and reuses appearance in the local coordinate systems of 3D boxes. Box-Surface Latent Memory retains image latents on box faces and retrieves them along rays in the target view. Geometry-Aligned Memory Conditioning supplies the retrieved tokens to a FLUX.2 editor using target-view positions, shared box-local embeddings, and object-wise attention. A correspondence loss encourages the editor to attend to matching observations during denoising. We also introduce LayoutLoop, a multi-round 3D layout-controlled image editing benchmark with calibrated layouts and designed revisits. We conduct extensive experiments on LayoutLoop and real-scene data to verify the ability of our method. The project page is at https://ykchizs.github.io/layoutrecall.github.io/.
items.tldr: LayoutRecall propose une méthode de *multi-round 3D layout-controlled image editing* qui préserve l'apparence des objets lors de réapparitions après occlusion, via un système de mémoire latente alignée sur des boîtes 3D. Intéressant pour l'édition d'images 3D avec contrôle géométrique précis, mais limité à un cas d'usage spécifique.

items.title: JosssphZhou/poki
items.summary: Poki uses your iPhone like you do. An open-source agent app that runs on your iPhone, reads the screen, and taps, types and swipes in real apps with your own model account.
items.tldr: Application open-source pour iPhone permettant à un agent IA d'interagir avec des apps locales via écran et actions tactiles, avec support de modèles personnels.

items.summary: maxxing the ability to run different LLMs on the smallest devices possible

items.title: Decision-Native Multimodal Clinical Modeling via Anatomical Grounding and Confidence Calibration
items.summary: Structured clinical decisions from volumetric computed tomography (CT) require anatomically grounded predictions and calibrated confidence estimates. However, existing 3D medical multimodal models often suffer from uncalibrated autoregressive decoding and shortcut reliance on irrelevant anatomical regions. We introduce Radev, a decision-native multimodal model that integrates anatomy-guided visual compression, direct candidate prediction, and counterfactual confidence supervision. To bridge global context with fine-grained slice details, a frozen 3D encoder extracts reusable organ-level features, which are dynamically selected by the query to attend to 2D slice features within predicted anatomical bounds. The resulting compact visual tokens enable the language backbone to estimate candidate probabilities in a single forward pass without autoregressive decoding. We further propose Counterfactual-Calibrated Training (CCT) to compare predictions under intact and intervened organ representations. CCT encourages confidence to decrease when removing target-organ evidence degrades decision quality, while penalizing excessive confidence drops under unrelated-organ removal. To facilitate rigorous evaluation, we construct CT-Verdict, a comprehensive benchmark spanning binary finding presence, multiple-choice questions, and ordinal severity assessment across both in-distribution and external cohorts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Radev significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both decision accuracy and confidence calibration, while generalizing robustly under distribution shifts. Project page at https://juntaojianggavin.github.io/projects/Radev/
items.tldr: Radev introduit un modèle clinique multimodal *decision-native* avec calibration de confiance et supervision contrefactuelle, pour des prédictions anatomiquement ancrées en imagerie 3D. Pertinent pour l'interprétabilité et les LLM médicaux.

items.title: RunanywhereAI/trnrt
items.summary: The open LLM inference engine for AWS Trainium: NKI megakernels, 1M-token context, OpenAI-compatible API. By RunAnywhere.
items.tldr: Moteur d'inférence LLM optimisé pour AWS Trainium avec support de contextes 1M tokens et API OpenAI, mais limité à une infrastructure spécifique.

items.title: TIGER-AI-Lab/WebsiteBench
items.summary: Can AI agents rebuild websites through browser exploration?
items.tldr: Benchmark évaluant la capacité des agents IA à reconstruire des sites web via exploration de navigateur, avec une approche méthodique mais limitée à un cas d'usage spécifique.

items.title: GGUF LLM Models with Hidden Malware on Hugging Face Reached 2400 Victims
items.tldr: Des modèles GGUF hébergés sur Hugging Face ont été infectés par des malwares, exploitant des vulnérabilités dans les formats de quantization, soulignant les risques de sécurité dans les écosystèmes de modèles légers.

items.title: Damped Atomic Wave Integration Neurons (DAWIN): A Universal Primitive for Continuous-Time Spatiotemporal Learning
items.summary: Conventional artificial neurons separate spatial feature aggregation from continuous physical time, limiting their ability to model irregular observations. We introduce the Damped Atomic Wave Integration Neuron (DAWIN), a continuous-time primitive for replacing standard neural layers in MLPs, Transformers, and graph neural networks. DAWIN couples spatial projection with elapsed-time-dependent wave excitation and integrates it into a local complex state through closed-form damped evolution, avoiding numerical differential equation solvers. We show that DAWIN generalizes static sinusoidal and memoryless wave neurons on interval-augmented inputs, derive closed-form gradients, and establish bounded-input bounded-output stability for positive damping and sampling intervals bounded away from zero. An associative Triton prefix-scan implementation, DAWINLinear, uses FP32 accumulation and achieves O(log L) parallel depth for sequence length L. Across 11 parameter-matched tasks covering irregular oscillators, MuJoCo dynamics, pedestrian trajectories, and PhysioNet 2012 clinical sequences, DAWIN outperforms Neural CDE on 9 tasks and ReLU-MLP on 8. It achieves the lowest error on dense clinical dynamics (0.9531 NRMSE, winning across all 10 seeds) and ties for the best mortality prediction (0.9993 AUROC). Shuffling elapsed intervals increases error by 58.2%-77.4% on selected dynamics tasks, versus 0.06% on a time-irrelevant control, supporting reliance on physical timing. On NVIDIA B200 GPUs, parallel wave integration accelerates inference by up to 2,630 times over its serial implementation and reduces peak GPU memory by up to 97.6% relative to Mamba in the tested configurations.
items.tldr: DAWIN introduit un neurone continu pour le *spatiotemporal learning* combinant projection spatiale et excitation temporelle, avec des gains sur des tâches irrégulières. Approche théorique solide mais peu directe pour les centres d'intérêt de l'utilisateur.

items.title: Claude Code sabotage: preliminary benchmarking
items.tldr: Une analyse préliminaire (benchmark) sur le sabotage de Claude Code, mettant en lumière des vulnérabilités dans les agents IA et leurs impacts sur la fiabilité des outils de développement.

items.title: sous-labs/songe
items.summary: A training engine for your local model, using your idle compute
items.tldr: Moteur de fine-tuning local utilisant des ressources inutilisées, mais manque de transparence sur les algorithmes ou performances.

items.title: Future-Proof-DS/interactive-ai-ml-tools
items.summary: Free interactive tools for data scientists to learn MLOps, ML system design and agentic analytics: a production ML system map, ML project structure, data drift simulator, agentic analytics system map and AI evals.
items.tldr: Collection d'outils interactifs pour concevoir des systèmes ML/agents (MLOps, évaluation, dérive de données). Utile pour la productisation des agents, mais manque de profondeur théorique et de validation par des benchmarks standardisés.

items.title: mankidev/antialgorithm
items.summary: Agent skill that steers the model away from its first, most average pick in creative work: names, ideas, logo, posters, UI.
items.tldr: Agent IA conçu pour éviter les réponses génériques dans des tâches créatives (noms, idées, designs), mais approche heuristique sans validation rigoureuse.

items.title: Convex skills send the user's app idea to a remote server without telling them
items.tldr: Une application (Convex) envoyant des données utilisateurs vers un serveur distant sans consentement, illustrant les enjeux de transparence et de privacy dans les outils IA grand public.

items.title: nexu-io/opengame
items.summary: The Super Game Agent — the Unity & Unreal for AI agents, with 100+ viral games to remix. Turn 20+ coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, DeepSeek, etc.) into a full-stack AI game studio. Build and publish 3D & mini-games to WeChat, Douyin, TikTok, Telegram, itch.io, and more.
items.tldr: Plateforme de développement de jeux 3D pour agents IA (Unity/Unreal-like) avec intégration de multiples modèles (Claude, DeepSeek). Prometteur pour l'écosystème agents, mais orienté produit commercial sans fond théorique ou benchmarks.
